thread:
maria: Heads-up — pushing a draft playbook and sample audit payloads for the upcoming audit-change rollout (RBAC deltas + KMS field changes). Putting the customer preview packet in Google Drive: https://drive.redwood/audit-playbook-preview :eyes:
leo: thanks — quick Q: are we changing the schema field names or just adding optional properties? specifically, will `actor.role` become `actor.roles` (array)?
mar ia: typo — maria: We are adding optional arrays and a small set of new event types. `actor.roles` will be an array, `actor.role` kept for backwards compat as a string for one-off older clients. New recommended consumers should read `actor.roles` first.
sam_g: can you paste a sample payload inline? easier for customers to grep in their validators.
maria: sure — sample below (redacted):
```json
{
  "event_type": "model.deploy",
  "timestamp": "2024-11-15T18:12:33Z",
  "actor": {
    "id": "svc-12345",
    "display_name": "deploy-bot",
    "roles": ["service_principal"],
    "session_id": "s-abcde"
  },
  "resource": {
    "id": "model-ggml-1",
    "kind": "model_revision",
    "tags": ["stable"]
  },
  "metadata": {
    "kek_id": "redacted",
    "kms_key_alias": "projects/redwood/keys/pack-2024"
  }
}
```
leo: thanks — for KMS: will `kek_id` be present for all events or only encryption-related ops? customers asked about PII risk.
maria: only present for crypto-related ops (key rotation, key import, model secrets binding). For other events we send `kms_key_alias` as a human-friendly string. We will redaction-mask `kek_id` for customer-facing samples and provide an optional flag for customers to request full-ids under NDA.
eva_cs: from CS: customers want a short change-note and a validation checklist they can run against their ingestion pipeline. Can we provide a 3-step checklist and a small validator script?
maria: yes — included in the packet: 1) confirm `actor.roles` array presence, 2) validate `event_type` mapping doc, 3) run schema-lint (we'll publish a small `audit-lint` npm/pip). Also adding a minimal `jq` based example.
d an: alert — vuln triage note: the RBAC delta (service_principal role) flagged a codepath in authz microservice that allowed `null` role entries. We've patched in staging and added a log-level test. PR #3245 ready for review.
sam_g: good catch. Can we add a customer-facing line like "No change to access controls; this is telemetry-only"?
maria: yes, we'll add that to the communication. Draft line: "This update expands the audit event schema to provide richer actor and KMS metadata for improved observability. It does not change access control behavior." Thoughts?
eva_cs: LGTM. Add a short FAQ Q/A: "Will this expose my key material?" Answer: "No — we never transmit key material. `kek_id` is an identifier and will be redacted in public samples."
leo: timeline? when do we plan to announce to customers and when to flip feature flag?
maria: proposal: internal rollout -> 2 weeks of canary -> customer preview (opt-in) -> GA. Opt-in preview email goes out next Tuesday if legal + product sign off today.
security-bot: automated-check: schema-regression-tests PASSED (14/14), lint: WARN on legacy fields present (fine), risk-score: low.
infra-bot: canary metrics to watch: audit-event-rate, event-size-p50/p95, schema-lint-failures. Will add dashboards under Console -> Observability -> Audit.
sam_g: small request: include a short code sample for validators using our SDKs (python + node). Customers can copy/paste.
maria: yep — included. Also adding changelog bullets: - added `actor.roles` (array) - added `session_id` to actor - added `kek_id` & `kms_key_alias` under metadata (redacted by default) - introduced `model.*` event types - backwards compatible with `actor.role` (string).
dan: running final quick review on PR and customer packet in the next hour. If all green I'll merge and tag release-candidate.
eva_cs: I'll draft the customer email and include a short checklist and sample payload. Sending you a draft in DMs, @maria.
maria: thanks everyone — assign owners? I’ll own the schema docs and changelog, @sam_g you own SDK validator examples, @eva_cs the customer comms, @dan final PR + rollout. Ping me if anything blocks. :rocket:
